main_text.p: iii.[Porrò ; Encliticæ non semper reji-ciunt accentum suum in præcedentem syllabam: sed quandoque etiam prorsus amittunt ; quandoque verò retinent.
Rejiciunt, si præcedens dictio illius capax sit. putà,si fuerit illa,
1. Omnes encliticæ; si præcedens dictio fuerit ἐπιπωλαιωμένη, vel ὀξύτοννﬠ. (hoc enim casu, gravis duntaxat inscriptus redit in acutum.) ut: ποιηταὶ γε, ἀφός τις.
2. Monosyllabæ tantùm ; si præcedat dictio παροξύτοννﬠ non - trochaica: ut: ἀπειδῆς τε, λέγειν τι, πάρﬠ γε.
1. Pronomina;quando ἐνκλινῶς aut ἐμφατικῶς usurpantur. Ac tùm ferè etiam,in constructione orationis,præponi solent. ut: μὴ ἡκασας, σοι λέγω.

page.notes: Greek text is transcribed approximately; accents and breathings in the scan are faint. The marginal mark "iii." at upper right is a printed note. Several Greek words are uncertain and not individually marked.
